title: A stable framework for proper and exterior homotopy and cohomology theories
summary: We develop a stable framework for exterior homotopy theory and apply it to proper homotopy theory. Starting from a known simplicial model structure on the category of exterior spaces we then pass to the proper, cellular model category of retractive exterior spaces over the ray, and establish the associated stable homotopy theory of exterior spectra.
